g.text: Power: J1 (KL25 USB) or J2 (UART USB), each through its PTC fuse to the TPS2116,

g.desc: Power: J1 (KL25 USB) or J2 (UART USB), each through its PTC fuse to the TPS2116,

g.text: which takes J1 whenever it is present and blocks reverse current. The CP2102N runs

g.desc: which takes J1 whenever it is present and blocks reverse current. The CP2102N runs

g.text: from 3.3 V and senses J2's VBUS (R15, R16); R27 bleeds mux leakage off VBUS2, so it

g.desc: from 3.3 V and senses J2's VBUS (R15, R16); R27 bleeds mux leakage off VBUS2, so it

g.text: connects only when a host is on J2.

g.desc: connects only when a host is on J2.

g.text: would overdrive the crystal (AN3208 Eqn. 1), and RF must not be fitted (DS Table 19).
